name: Capability pitch letter writer
why: Turns what the firm can do into a short pitch letter where every line can be shown, a companion to the capability statement.

name: Prepare an enterprise account plan
why: Maps buyer roles and deal risks for a target account, the same ground as the account plan skill.

name: Partnership experiment planner
why: Plans a small, capped partnership test with measures and a stop rule before a bigger commitment.

name: Cold email claim checker
why: Checks each claim in an intro email against the facts before it goes to a buyer.

name: Cold outreach batch runner
why: Runs intro emails in checked weekly batches and learns from the last batch, like the weekly cycle in the campaign workflow.

name: Stranger first-message writer
why: Writes a first email or call opening a busy buyer can read in seconds.

name: Sales call question planner
why: Plans questions for first meetings and site walks from what you already know about the buyer.

name: Problem cost question writer
why: Writes questions that surface what a buyer's problem costs them, the Metrics and Pain in MEDDICC.

name: Stalled deal revival desk
why: Finds why a quiet deal stalled and what to send next, a follow-on to the MEDDICC review.

name: Deal win reason finder
why: Finds why buyers really choose the firm, which feeds the rules for a good account and the why-choose-us facts.

name: Elevator pitch writer
why: Short spoken versions of the capability statement for site visits and networking.
